1171: Why do you water salt ground? You only waste your life.
ਕਾਚੀ ਢਹਗਿ ਦਿਵਾਲ; ਕਾਹੇ ਗਚੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
A wall of mud will surely fall; why plaster it with lime? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਰ ਹਰਿਹਟ, ਮਾਲ ਟਿੰਡ ਪਰੋਵਹੁ; ਤਿਸੁ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਜੋਵਹੁ ॥
Make the work of your hands the Persian wheel, string its chain with buckets, and yoke your mind to it;
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਿੰਚਹੁ. ਭਰਹੁ ਕਿਆਰੇ; ਤਉ ਮਾਲੀ ਕੇ ਹੋਵਹੁ ॥੨॥
water with the life-giving Name and fill the beds of your senses; then you become dear to the Gardener. ॥2॥
ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਦੁਇ. ਕਰਹੁ ਬਸੋਲੇ; ਗੋਡਹੁ ਧਰਤੀ ਭਾਈ ॥
Make love and anger your two hoes, brother, and weed the field of your body;
ਜਿਉ ਗੋਡਹੁ. ਤਿਉ ਤੁਮੑ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹੁ; ਕਿਰਤੁ. ਨ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
the more you weed, the more peace you enjoy; such labour does not go to waste. ॥3॥
ਬਗੁਲੇ ਤੇ ਫੁਨਿ ਹੰਸੁਲਾ ਹੋਵੈ; ਜੇ ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
If You show mercy, O merciful Lord, even a heron can become a swan.
ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ; ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੯॥
Nanak, slave of Your slaves, prays: show mercy, O merciful Lord. ॥4॥1॥9॥
ਸਾਹੁਰੜੀ ਵਥੁ. ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਝੀ; ਪੇਵਕੜੈ ਧਨ ਵਖੇ ॥
The gift from the Husband's home was there for all to share, but in this world, my parents' home, I learnt only to keep apart.
ਆਪਿ ਕੁਚਜੀ. ਦੋਸੁ, ਨ ਦੇਊ; ਜਾਣਾ ਨਾਹੀ. ਰਖੇ ॥੧॥
I was clumsy myself and can blame no one; I never learnt how to keep the gift safe. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ; ਹਉ ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੀ ॥
O my Master, I strayed by myself, lost in wandering.
ਅਖਰ ਲਿਖੇ ਸੇਈ ਗਾਵਾ; ਅਵਰ. ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I sing only the letters my past deeds have carved in me; I know no other way to fashion it. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਢਿ ਕਸੀਦਾ. ਪਹਿਰਹਿ ਚੋਲੀ; ਤਾਂ ਤੁਮੑ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
Those who embroider fine virtues and wear the robe of love, know them as true wives;
ਜੇ ਘਰੁ ਰਾਖਹਿ. ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਚਾਖਹਿ; ਹੋਵਹਿ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੨॥
those who guard their house and taste no evil become dear to the Husband. ॥2॥
ਜੇ ਤੂੰ ਪੜਿਆ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਬੀਨਾ; ਦੁਇ ਅਖਰ. ਦੁਇ ਨਾਵਾ ॥
If you are truly a learned and wise pandit, know that the Name of God is the boat;
ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਏਕੁ ਲੰਘਾਏ; ਜੇ ਕਰਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਾਂ ॥੩॥੨॥੧੦॥
Nanak prays: the Name alone carries one across, if I stay merged in the eternal One. ॥3॥2॥10॥
ਰਾਜਾ ਬਾਲਕੁ. ਨਗਰੀ ਕਾਚੀ; ਦੁਸਟਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
The king, the mind, is a child, the city of the body is frail, and its love is for evil companions;
ਦੁਇ ਮਾਈ. ਦੁਇ ਬਾਪਾ ਪੜੀਅਹਿ; ਪੰਡਿਤ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
it is said to have two mothers and two fathers; O pandit, reflect on this. ॥1॥
O revered pandit, you give all sorts of other teaching;
by it how can I meet the Lord of my life? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਭੀਤਰਿ ਅਗਨਿ. ਬਨਾਸਪਤਿ ਮਉਲੀ; ਸਾਗਰੁ ਪੰਡੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Within the body burns the fire of vice, youth surges like green growth, and an ocean of desire swells in this frame;
ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ. ਘਰ ਹੀ ਭੀਤਰਿ; ਐਸਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ. ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
peace like the moon and divine radiance like the sun are both within the body; your teaching gives no such knowledge. ॥2॥
ਰਾਮ ਰਵੰਤਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ; ਇਕ ਮਾਈ ਭੋਗੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Know him to be remembering God who puts an end to one mother, ignorance;
ਤਾ ਕੇ ਲਖਣ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ; ਖਿਮਾ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੇਇ ॥੩॥
his marks are known by this: he gathers the wealth of forbearance. ॥3॥
ਕਹਿਆ ਸੁਣਹਿ ਨ ਖਾਇਆ ਮਾਨਹਿ; ਤਿਨੑਾ ਹੀ ਸੇਤੀ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
The mind dwells with senses that heed no teaching and are never sated;
ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ; ਖਿਨੁ ਤੋਲਾ ਖਿਨੁ ਮਾਸਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੧॥
Nanak, slave of Your slaves, prays: so the mind is a tola one moment and a masha the next. ॥4॥3॥11॥
ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ; ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ. ਭੁਖ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
The Guru is the true banker, the giver of peace; he unites one with God and removes the hunger for Maya.
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੧॥
In mercy he makes firm the longing for God, for he sings God's praises night and day. ॥1॥
ਮਤ ਭੂਲਹਿ; ਰੇ ਮਨ ਚੇਤਿ ਹਰੀ ॥
Do not forget Him, O mind; remember God.
ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ. ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ. ਤ੍ਰੈ ਲੋਈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Without the Guru there is no release from the hunger for Maya, search all three worlds; through the Guru the Name of God is found. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ. ਨਹੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ. ਨਹੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰੀ ॥
Without heartfelt longing the true Guru is not found, and without good fortune the longing for God does not arise;
ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ. ਸਤਸੰਗੁ, ਨ ਪਾਈਐ; ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੀ ॥੨॥
without good fortune the company of Gurmukhs is not found; God's Name comes only by His grace. ॥2॥
ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਉਪਾਏ ਵੇਖੈ; ਪਰਗਟੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ॥
He who creates and watches over all lies hidden in every heart, but is manifest to saints who turn to the Guru;
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ. ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਭੀਨੇ; ਹਰਿ ਜਲੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਾ ॥੩॥
they repeat God's Name, are steeped in His love, and the life-giving water of the Name dwells in their minds. ॥3॥
1172: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਤਖਤਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇ ਪਰਧਾਨ ਕੀਏ ॥
Those given the honour of sitting on the heart's throne through the Guru, God makes renowned;
ਪਾਰਸੁ ਭੇਟਿ. ਭਏ ਸੇ ਪਾਰਸ; ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਥੀਏ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੨॥
meeting the Guru, the philosopher's stone, they become such stones themselves, O Nanak, and stay ever with God and the Guru. ॥4॥4॥12॥
Basant · Dutuke · Guru Amar Das · Ghar 1
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
In all the months and seasons, You alone are ever in bloom,
by whose grace every creature has life.
What can I, a mere worm, say?
ਤੇਰਾ ਕਿਨੈ. ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤੁ ॥੧॥
No one has found Your beginning or Your end. ॥1॥
O Master, those who serve You
ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ; ਆਤਮ ਦੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
enjoy the highest bliss, O divine Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
When His grace comes, a person serves Him;
by the Guru's grace he stays free of vice while living and working in the world;
night and day he utters the eternal Name,
and in this way he crosses the ocean so hard to cross. ॥2॥
The Creator made both the poison of Maya and the nectar of the Name;
ਸੰਸਾਰ ਬਿਰਖ ਕਉ; ਦੁਇ ਫਲ ਲਾਏ ॥
He has put these two fruits on the tree of the world.
The Creator Himself does all and has all done;
He feeds each one whichever fruit He wills. ॥3॥
O Nanak, the one on whom He casts His glance of grace,
He Himself gives His life-giving Name,
and He stops in him the craving for Maya.
God Himself does as He wills. ॥4॥1॥
O Lord, those dyed in Your eternal Name stay glad at heart.
Show mercy, O God, merciful to the meek.
ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ; ਅਵਰੁ. ਨਹੀ ਮੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Apart from Him I see no other friend;
as He wills, so He protects. ॥1॥
The Guru, the Lord of the world, is dear to my mind;
ਰਹਿ. ਨ ਸਕਉ, ਦਰਸਨ ਦੇਖੇ ਬਿਨੁ; ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I cannot rest without seeing Him; when the Guru unites me, I meet Him in stillness of mind. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One whose greedy mind stays caught in greed
forgets God's Name and then wrings his hands.
Those dyed in the devotion the Guru teaches, the Guru reunites when they are parted;
to those whose fortune woke, he gave God's Name. ॥2॥
ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਕੀ; ਇਹ ਦੇਹ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
This body is made of air and water;
in one who has the disease of pride, severe pain stays in the body.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਦਾਰੂ; ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
For one who sings God's praises through the Guru, God's Name becomes the medicine;
in mercy the Guru has cured this disease. ॥3॥
Four rivers of fire flow, violence, attachment, greed and anger, and those with all four strong in their bodies
burn in craving and burn in pride.
The fortunate ones whom the Guru protected, he carried across;
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ; ਉਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
O Nanak, they enshrined God's life-giving Name in their hearts. ॥4॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵੇ; ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਲੋਗੁ ॥
One who remembers God is God's devotee;
ਸਾਚੁ ਸਹਜੁ; ਕਦੇ. ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
he has lasting stillness of mind, and sorrow never touches him.
ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਏ; ਨਾਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
But those who follow their own mind are spiritually dead, for God is not in their minds;
ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ; ਭੀ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
dying spiritually again and again, they keep being born, and die again. ॥1॥
ਸੇ ਜਨ ਜੀਵੇ; ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Those people truly live who keep God in their minds;
they cherish the eternal One and stay merged in the eternal One. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਰਿ. ਨ ਸੇਵਹਿ; ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
Those who do not serve God stay far from God;
they roam foreign lands and throw dust on their own heads.
God Himself keeps His devotees attached to Him;
ਤਿਨ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੈ; ਤਿਲੁ. ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
they have bliss for ever and not a speck of greed. ॥2॥
1173: One on whom He looks with grace loses his pride,
and he receives honour in the eternal court.
He sees God ever present beside him,
and through the Guru's word sees Him pervading everywhere. ॥3॥
whoever by the Guru's grace keeps Him ever in mind
ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ; ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
goes with honour to the eternal door, to His home.
O Nanak, through the Name he receives glory. ॥4॥3॥
Worship goes on within, from the mind itself;
he sees the One alone and no other.
Caught in love of Maya, the world has suffered great pain;
the true Guru has shown me the One alone. ॥1॥
My ever-joyful Lord has blossomed everywhere, in lasting spring;
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਉਲਿਆ; ਗਾਇ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
singing the Lord's praises, this mind stays in bloom. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Take the Guru's teaching and dwell on God's qualities;
then you come to love the eternal Lord.
If you give up self and abide as a servant,
then the world's Creator comes to dwell in your mind. ॥2॥
One who performs devotion sees Him ever beside him;
my Lord appears to him pervading everywhere.
ਇਸੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਕਾ; ਕੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਭੇਉ ॥
Whoever grasps the secret of this devotion
sees my Lord, the divine One, in all. ॥3॥
He Himself unites a person with the true Guru and joins him to Himself;
He Himself fixes that person's mind on Himself, the world's Creator.
Their mind and body stay green, poised in stillness and in His love;
O Nanak, so it is for those who keep their attention fixed on the Name. ॥4॥4॥
ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹਰਿ; ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
God, who loves devotion, comes to dwell in the mind
of one who by the Guru's grace stays poised in stillness and in His love.
When a person performs devotion, casting out self from within,
then alone comes union with the eternal One. ॥1॥
ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਸਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੁਆਰਿ ॥
Devotees always look beautiful at the door of God,
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ; ਸਾਚੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
in love of the Guru and in true love for the eternal One. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ; ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
One who performs devotion becomes pure in life;
through the Guru's word he casts out pride from within.
ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ; ਆਪਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
God Himself comes to dwell in his mind;
he has peace for ever and stays merged in bliss and stillness of mind. ॥2॥
Those dyed in the eternal One live ever in spring;
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ; ਰਵਿ ਗੁਣ ਗੁਵਿੰਦ ॥
dwelling on the Lord's virtues, their mind and body grow green.
Without the Name the world stays withered and small at heart,
and burns again and again in the fire of craving. ॥3॥
ਸੋਈ ਕਰੇ; ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
One who does only what pleases God
ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਰੀਰਿ; ਭਾਣੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
and fixes his mind on His will has lasting peace within.
One who serves his Lord in stillness and in His love,
O Nanak, the Name comes to dwell in his mind. ॥4॥5॥
One who burns attachment to Maya through the Word
grows green in mind and body through love of the true Guru.
The tree of his body bears fruit, as he stays at the Lord's door
in the eternal praise and in love of the Name. ॥1॥
O mind, abide in the love that brings stillness, and you will grow green;
ਸਚ ਫਲੁ ਲਾਗੈ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
through love of the true Guru the fruit of the eternal Name grows. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
He Himself seems near, and He Himself seems far;
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਵੇਖੈ ਸਦ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
one who through the Guru's word sees Him ever present
sees that by His light all vegetation is dense with shade and in flower;
one who turns to the Guru blossoms in stillness and in His love. ॥2॥
Those who sing His praises night and day:
the true Guru has rid them of the filth of wandering within.
1174: Beholding the world's play, such a one cries out in wonder;
but the gift of the Name is found by turning to the Guru. ॥3॥
The Creator Himself enjoys all tastes and pleasures;
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ; ਸੋਈ ਪਰੁ ਹੋਗ ॥
whatever He wills to do surely comes to pass.
He is the great Giver, with not a speck of greed.
O Nanak, He is met by living the Guru's word. ॥4॥6॥
One who by full fortune does the work of the eternal Name
ਏਕੋ ਚੇਤੈ; ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ. ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
and keeps the One alone in mind does not fall into births again.
ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ; ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
Fruitful is the life of one who has come into this world
and stays merged in the eternal Name in stillness of mind. ॥1॥
Turning to the Guru, do your work with your attention fixed on Him;
ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੇਵਹੁ; ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
remember God's Name, casting out self from within. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ; ਹੈ ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
That person's support is the eternal word of praise,
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਜਗ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
which pervades the world; he stays absorbed in the Guru's word.
His lasting glory spreads through the four ages;
one dyed in the Name becomes known in the world. ॥2॥
ਇਕਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Some keep their attention fixed on the eternal Word;
abiding in love of the eternal One, they become one with Him.
Seeing the eternal One beside them, they meditate on Him
ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ; ਪਗ ਪੰਕਜ ਧੂਰਿ ॥੩॥
and take the dust of the saints' lotus feet. ॥3॥
He sees one Creator alone and no other;
through the Guru's word his union with Him comes about.
ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ; ਤਿਨਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Whoever has served the eternal One has tasted bliss;
O Nanak, he stays merged in the Name in stillness of mind. ॥4॥7॥
Devotees worship Him, seeing Him beside them,
ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ; ਪਗ ਪੰਕਜ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
and take the dust of the saints' lotus feet;
ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ; ਸਦ ਰਹਹਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
they keep their attention ever fixed on God;
the perfect true Guru has given them this understanding. ॥1॥
ਦਾਸਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ; ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਈ ਹੋਇ ॥
Rare is one who becomes a servant of the servants;
such a one attains the highest spiritual rank. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Serve the One, like whom there is no other,
and serving whom brings lasting bliss.
ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ; ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
He never dies, nor comes and goes in birth and death.
ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ; ਅਵਰੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਕਿਉ ਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
Why should I serve any other but Him, O mother? ॥2॥
ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਚੇ; ਜਿਨੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥
Those who have recognised the eternal One become lasting themselves;
killing self, they stay merged in the Name in stillness of mind.
The Name is obtained through the Guru;
the mind becomes pure, and one sees the pure eternal Lord. ॥3॥
ਜਿਨਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਕੀਆ; ਤਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਤੂ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
Know deeply the Lord who gave you understanding;
through the word of eternal praise, come to know the one Lord.
ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੈ; ਤਾਂ ਸੁਧਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
When one tastes the relish of God's Name, understanding comes.
O Nanak, dyed in the Name, one sees that eternal Lord everywhere. ॥4॥8॥
ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ; ਕੁਲਾਂ ਕਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
Those dyed in the Name carry their whole lineage across;
eternal praise and love of the Name dwell in them.
Those who follow their own mind go astray; why did they even come?
Forgetting the Name, they waste their life. ॥1॥
He dies to Maya while living, and dying so, makes his life beautiful,
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਸਾਚੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
who holds the eternal Name in his heart through the Guru's word. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One who through the Guru makes the eternal Name his food becomes pure in body;
his mind is pure, and the deep Lord of virtues dwells in him ever.
He is not born, does not die, does not come and go;
by the Guru's grace he stays merged in the eternal One. ॥2॥
Serve the eternal One: whoever recognises Him
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੈ ॥
through the Guru's word is honoured at God's door.
1175: With the eternal Name in him, he has glory at the eternal door,
and he comes to dwell in his own home. ॥3॥
The eternal Lord Himself never errs;
ਹੋਰਿ ਸਭਿ ਭੂਲਹਿ; ਦੂਜੈ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥
all others err, losing their honour in love of Maya.
Serve the eternal One through the eternal word of praise;
O Nanak, through the Name one's mind merges in the eternal One. ॥4॥9॥
Without His grace all the world strays in wandering
and, caught in attachment to Maya, suffers great pain.
Those who follow their own mind are blind and find no resting place;
ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕਾ ਕੀੜਾ; ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
they are like the worm of filth that stays absorbed in filth. ॥1॥
One who accepts His will is approved;
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਨਾਮਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
through the Guru's word he is joined to the Name and receives honour. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤੇ; ਜਿਨੑਾ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Those with devotion written on their foreheads from the start are dyed in the eternal Name;
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
God's Name is ever dear to their minds.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ; ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Through the true Guru's word they have lasting bliss,
and it merges their light in His light. ॥2॥
The one Name carries the world across,
but love of the Name comes by the Guru's grace.
ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ; ਕਿਨੈ. ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
Without the Name no one has won release;
ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ; ਨਾਮੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
the Name is received from the perfect Guru. ॥3॥
He alone understands whom God Himself makes understand;
through service of the true Guru He fixes the Name within him.
ਜਿਨ ਇਕੁ ਜਾਤਾ; ਸੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Those who know the One are approved;
O Nanak, dyed in the Name, they are honoured at His door. ॥4॥10॥
When He shows mercy, He unites one with the true Guru,
and He Himself comes to dwell in that mind.
His intellect stays unshaken, his mind ever steady;
he sings the praises of God, the deep treasure of virtues. ॥1॥
Those who forget the Name eat poison and die spiritually;
ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ; ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
their life is wasted and they keep coming and going. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਬਹੁ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਹਿ; ਮਨਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ. ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Many put on religious garbs, yet find no peace of mind;
through great pride one loses his honour.
Fortunate are those who have recognised the Word
and brought the wandering mind back home. ॥2॥
Within the home is the treasure of the unreachable, boundless Lord;
those who search by the Guru's teaching, reflecting on the Word,
ਨਾਮੁ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ; ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
have found the Name, the nine treasures, in their own heart;
they stay ever dyed in His love and merged in the eternal One. ॥3॥
ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ; ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣੁ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
He Himself does all; nothing can be done by us;
when it pleases Him, He unites one with Himself.
ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਨੇੜੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
By his own effort no one is near Him or far from Him.
O Nanak, one who abides in the Name sees Him pervading all. ॥4॥11॥
Remembering God with love through the Guru's word,
one stays sated by the relish of God's Name.
ਕੋਟ ਕੋਟੰਤਰ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ; ਜਲਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Burnt away are the sins of countless births of those
who, merged in God's Name, die to Maya while living. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਦਾਤਿ; ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
God Himself knows to whom to give His gift.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਉਲਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
This mind blossoms through the Guru's word in one who utters God's Name, giver of virtues. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਭਗਵੈ ਵੇਸਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ; ਮੁਕਤਿ. ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Wandering in saffron robes brings no release;
ਬਹੁ ਸੰਜਮਿ; ਸਾਂਤਿ. ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
by much austerity no one finds peace.
One who takes the Guru's teaching obtains the Name;
In this world of strife, glory comes through God's Name.
1176: This Name is received only from the perfect Guru.
Dyed in the Name, a person enjoys happiness for ever.
Without the Name, a person burns his spiritual life to ash in the fire of pride. ॥3॥
The fortunate one who holds God's Name in his thoughts,
through the Name all his suffering comes to an end.
He who dwells in the heart is the same One spread through the world outside.
O Nanak, such a person knows the Creator to be dwelling everywhere. ॥4॥12॥
O Lord, I am a lowly creature of Your own making,
only if You give it can I repeat Your mantra of the true Name. ॥1॥
O my mother, may I utter God's virtues and keep them in my mind,
ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ; ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਲਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and, repeating God's Name, stay joined to His feet. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Only by the Guru's grace can a person take to the relish of the Name.
Why are you wasting your life in enmity and strife? ॥2॥
The one on whom the Guru had mercy lost his arrogance,
and, resting in the love that gives stillness of mind, he obtained God's Name. ॥3॥
The work of reading the word of God's praise is the best and the highest,
so Nanak keeps uttering the Name of the eternal Lord. ॥4॥1॥13॥
As all vegetation turns green when spring arrives,
so this mind turns green with spiritual life in the company of the Guru. ॥1॥
O my foolish mind, keep remembering the ever-lasting Lord,
ਤਾਂ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ; ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
only then, O my mind, will you enjoy bliss. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
This mind has bloomed and bliss has arisen within the one
who has obtained the Name of Gobind, the fruit that gives spiritual life. ॥2॥
Everyone says and declares that God alone is everywhere,
but only when a person understands His will does he come to know Him closely. ॥3॥
ਕਹਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ; ਹਉਮੈ ਕਹੈ. ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Says Nanak: then a person no longer says "I, I".
ਆਖਣੁ ਵੇਖਣੁ ਸਭੁ; ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੪॥
A being says and sees only what the Master prompts. ॥4॥2॥14॥
O Lord, all the ages are of Your making.
In one who meets the Guru, wisdom and understanding arise. ॥1॥
O dear Lord, the one whom You Yourself unite with You
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਸਚ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
stays absorbed in Your eternal Name through the Guru's word. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Those in whose minds the ever-blooming Lord dwells all come alive spiritually in this world,
ਫਲਹਿ ਫੁਲੀਅਹਿ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
they flourish in the world too, and through God's Name bliss stays within them. ॥2॥
Spiritual bloom is always within the one who holds the Guru's word in his mind
and keeps God's Name set in his heart. ॥3॥
ਮਨਿ ਬਸੰਤੁ; ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥
When the ever-blooming Lord dwells in a person's mind, his body and mind come alive spiritually.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਬਿਰਖੁ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੫॥
O Nanak, this body is a tree, and such a person's tree bears the fruit of God's Name. ॥4॥3॥15॥
ਤਿਨੑ ਬਸੰਤੁ; ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
Spiritual bloom stays within those who keep singing God's virtues.
By great good fortune God Himself has a person do His devotion. ॥1॥
ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ; ਬਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਲਗੈ. ਨ ਸੋਇ ॥
The touch of spiritual bloom never reaches the mind of one
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਜਲਿਆ; ਦੂਜੈ ਦੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
whose mind, caught in love of Maya and in mine-and-yours, brings spiritual death on itself. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਬਾਂਧਾ; ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
One whose mind stays bound in Maya's business, and who does his deeds in that state,
is robbed of spiritual life by Maya and is always in misery. ॥2॥
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਛੂਟੈ; ਜਾਂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ॥
This mind escapes when a person meets the Guru,
ਜਮਕਾਲ ਕੀ; ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ. ਨ ਫੇਟੈ ॥੩॥
and then he does not come under the blow of spiritual death. ॥3॥
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਛੂਟਾ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਲੀਆ ਛਡਾਇ ॥
The mind of the one whom the Guru set free has escaped.
O Nanak, he burns away attachment to Maya with the help of the Guru's word. ॥4॥4॥16॥
As all vegetation blossoms when the season of spring begins,
ਏਹਿ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਫੂਲਹਿ; ਹਰਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
so all these beings blossom with spiritual life by fixing their minds on God. ॥1॥
1177: ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ; ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥
In this way the mind becomes full of spiritual life
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ. ਹਉਮੈ ਕਢੈ ਧੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
in one who repeats God's Name day and night and, taking the Guru's refuge, washes pride out of himself. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
When this world hears the Guru's bani and the Guru's word,
and is absorbed in the Guru's love, it turns green with spiritual life. ॥2॥
ਫਲ ਫੂਲ ਲਾਗੇ; ਜਾਂ ਆਪੇ ਲਾਏ ॥
Flowers and fruit appear only when God Himself brings them forth.
A person is joined to the Creator of the whole world when he finds the Guru. ॥3॥
He Himself is the spring, and this whole world is His garden.
O Nanak, the devotion that keeps one untouched by Maya is found only by great good fortune. ॥4॥5॥17॥
Basant Hindol · Guru Amar Das · Ghar 2
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਵਿਟਹੁ. ਵਾਰਿਆ ਭਾਈ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਵਿਟਹੁ. ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
O brother, I am a sacrifice to the Guru's bani and to the Guru's word.
ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਦ ਅਪਣਾ ਭਾਈ; ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥
I always praise my Guru and fix my mind on the Guru's feet. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
O my mind, fix your attention on God's Name.
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ; ਇਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Your mind and body will bloom when you obtain the fruit of God's Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ. ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਭਾਈ; ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਇ ॥
Those whom the Guru protected were saved; he gave them the life-giving nectar of the Name to drink.
ਵਿਚਹੁ. ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਉਠਿ ਗਇਆ ਭਾਈ; ਸੁਖੁ ਵੁਠਾ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
The pain of pride left them, and bliss came to dwell in their minds. ॥2॥
ਧੁਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਨੋ ਬਖਸਿਓਨੁ ਭਾਈ; ਸਬਦੇ ਲਇਅਨੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
Those on whom God Himself bestowed grace from the first, He joined to the Guru's word.
ਧੂੜਿ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਕੀ. ਅਘੁਲੀਐ ਭਾਈ; ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
The dust of their feet leaves one untouched by Maya; He brings them into the company of the holy and joins them to Himself. ॥3॥
ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਭਾਈ; ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿਆ ਕੀਆ. ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
God, who gave life to every being, Himself causes all to be done and Himself does it.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਦ ਵਸੈ ਭਾਈ; ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੮॥੧੨॥੧੮॥੩੦॥
O Nanak, bliss always dwells in the mind and body of one who is united with God through the Guru's word. ॥4॥1॥18॥12॥18॥30॥
Basant · Iktuke · Guru Ram Das · Ghar 1
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
As the light of the sun's rays is spread everywhere,
ਤਿਉ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਮਈਆ; ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ॥੧॥
so the beautiful Lord is present in every body, like warp and weft. ॥1॥
Though the one God is present in every place,
He can be met only through the Guru's word, O my mother. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਏਕੋ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
That one God pervades within every body.
If one meets the Guru, He is plainly seen. ॥2॥
The one God alone fills every place and every particle.
But greedy people, cut off from God, think He lives somewhere far away. ॥3॥
The one God alone is at work throughout the world.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋੁ ਕਰੇ; ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੧॥
O Nanak, whatever that all-pervading Lord does is what happens. ॥4॥1॥
Night and day are both sounding death's summons.
ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ; ਅੰਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਰਖਿ ਲਏ ॥੧॥
O mind, remember God's Name, which always protects at the last moment. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿ; ਸਦਾ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
O my mind, always remember God,
ਸਭੁ ਆਲਸੁ ਦੂਖ ਭੰਜਿ. ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and sing God's virtues by the Guru's teaching; one who did so cast off all laziness and suffering and found God. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Those who follow their own minds bring spiritual death on themselves again and again through pride.
1178: ਕਾਲਿ ਦੈਤਿ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ; ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਗਏ ॥੨॥
When the demon Death struck them down, they fell into the power of death's messengers. ॥2॥
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ; ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
In those who face the Guru, devotion to God's Name takes hold,
and both their pains, of birth and of death, are gone. ॥3॥
ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ; ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
God Himself shows mercy to His devotees.
The one to whom Guru Nanak was gracious met God. ॥4॥2॥
Basant Hindol · Guru Ram Das · Ghar 2
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨ ਕੋਠੜੀ; ਗੜ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਏਕ ਲੁਕਾਨੀ ॥
God's Name is a treasury of jewels, lying hidden in the fort and temple of the body.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ. ਤ ਖੋਜੀਐ; ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
When the Guru is met it can be searched for; meeting him, a person's soul merges in God's light. ॥1॥
O Lord of Maya, let me, Your servant, meet the Guru.
ਦੇਖਤ ਦਰਸੁ. ਪਾਪ ਸਭਿ ਨਾਸਹਿ; ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
At the sight of the Guru all sins are destroyed, and one gains the pure and highest state. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਨਗਰੀਆ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਹਿਰਿਆ ॥
The five thieves together keep breaking into the town of the body and steal the wealth of God's Name.
ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਖੋਜ ਪਰੇ. ਤਬ ਪਕਰੇ; ਧਨੁ ਸਾਬਤੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਉਬਰਿਆ ॥੨॥
When someone tracks them by the Guru's teaching they are caught, and his wealth and capital are saved whole. ॥2॥
ਪਾਖੰਡ ਭਰਮ ਉਪਾਵ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਕੇ; ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
People tire themselves with efforts of show and superstition, while in their hearts there is only Maya.
ਸਾਧੂ ਪੁਰਖੁ. ਪੁਰਖਪਤਿ ਪਾਇਆ; ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
But one who finds the Guru, the great being, drives out the darkness of ignorance from within. ॥3॥
ਜਗੰਨਾਥ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਗੁਸਾਈ; ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਾਧੁ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥
When the Master of the world in His mercy brings a person to the Guru,
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਾਂਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਨਿਤ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
O Nanak, stillness stays in his mind and he always sings God's virtues in his heart. ॥4॥1॥3॥
ਤੁਮੑ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ, ਵਡ ਅਗਮ ਗੁਸਾਈ; ਹਮ ਕੀਰੇ ਕਿਰਮ. ਤੁਮਨਛੇ ॥
You are the greatest being, beyond reach, the Master of the world; we are lowly worms of Your making.
ਹਰਿ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਹਮ ਬਨਛੇ ॥੧॥
O Lord, merciful to the poor, show mercy; I long for the feet of the true Guru. ॥1॥
ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਜੀਉ. ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ; ਕਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਛੇ ॥
O dear Gobind, in Your mercy bring me into the company of the holy.
ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਮਲੁ ਭਰਿਆ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਨਛੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I am smeared with the filth of the sins of many births; O Lord, join me to that company and make my life clean. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤੁਮੑਰਾ ਜਨੁ, ਜਾਤਿ ਅਵਿਜਾਤਾ; ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ, ਪਤਿਤ. ਪਵੀਛੇ ॥
Your servant, whether of high caste or low, who has repeated Your Name that purifies sinners,
ਹਰਿ ਕੀਓ ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਤੇ ਊਪਰਿ; ਹਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਿਨਛੇ ॥੨॥
You have raised above all the world, O Lord, and given him honour. ॥2॥
ਜਾਤਿ ਅਜਾਤਿ ਕੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਿਆਵੈ; ਸਭਿ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਾਨਸ ਤਿਨਛੇ ॥
Of high caste or low, whoever meditates on God has all his aims fulfilled.
ਸੇ ਧੰਨਿ ਵਡੇ. ਵਡ ਪੂਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ; ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਓ, ਹਰਿ ਉਰਛੇ ॥੩॥
God's servants who have set Him in their hearts are blessed, the greatest, and perfect. ॥3॥
ਹਮ ਢੀਂਢੇ ਢੀਮ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ; ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਛੇ ॥
We are low and foolish, weighed down by a great load of sins; O Lord, show mercy and meet us.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ. ਹਰਿ ਤੂਠੇ; ਹਮ ਕੀਏ ਪਤਿਤ. ਪਵੀਛੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੪॥
O servant Nanak, God was gracious and we found the Guru, who made us sinners pure. ॥4॥2॥4॥
ਮੇਰਾ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਰਹਿ. ਨ ਸਕੈ; ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਸਿ ਗੀਧੇ ॥
My mind cannot go on for a moment without it; it is always absorbed in the taste of God's Name,
ਜਿਉ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ. ਰਸਕਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਥਨਿ ਮਾਤਾ; ਥਨਿ ਕਾਢੇ ਬਿਲਲ ਬਿਲੀਧੇ ॥੧॥
as an infant clings with relish to its mother's breast and wails when the breast is taken away. ॥1॥
ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਜੀਉ; ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਬੀਧੇ ॥
O dear Gobind, my mind and body are pierced by Your Name.
ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਵਿਚਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰ ਹਰਿ ਸੀਧੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
By great good fortune I found the true Guru, and I have found God within the town of the body. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
1179: ਜਨ ਕੇ ਸਾਸ. ਸਾਸ ਹੈ ਜੇਤੇ; ਹਰਿ ਬਿਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹਰਿ ਬੀਧੇ ॥
Every breath that God's servant has is pierced with longing for God.
ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ; ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਦੇਖੇ, ਸੁਕਲੀਧੇ ॥੨॥
So the lotus loves water very deeply and withers when it cannot see it. ॥2॥
ਜਨ ਜਪਿਓ. ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਨਰਹਰਿ; ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਧੇ ॥
God's servants repeat His pure Name; by his teaching the Guru has shown them God before their eyes.
ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਨਿਕਸੀ; ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਲਿ ਨੀਧੇ ॥੩॥
The filth of pride of birth after birth is gone, and they bathe in the life-giving water of God's Name. ॥3॥
ਹਮਰੇ ਕਰਮ. ਨ ਬਿਚਰਹੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ; ਤੁਮੑ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਹੁ ਅਪਨੀਧੇ ॥
O Master, do not weigh our deeds; protect the honour of Your own servant.
ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਬਿਨਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਰਣਿ ਪਵੀਧੇ ॥੪॥੩॥੫॥
O Lord, hear my plea as it pleases You; servant Nanak has come to Your refuge. ॥4॥3॥5॥
ਮਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਬਹੁ ਧਾਵੈ; ਤਿਲੁ ਘਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
The mind strays and runs about every moment and does not rest in its own home even for an instant.
ਗੁਰਿ ਅੰਕਸੁ. ਸਬਦੁ ਦਾਰੂ ਸਿਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਓ; ਘਰਿ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਆਣਿ ਵਸਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
The Guru's word is the remedy: the Guru set this goad on a person's head and brought his mind to rest in the home and temple of the heart. ॥1॥
ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਜੀਉ, ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ; ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
O dear Gobind, bring me into the company of the holy, where You can be meditated on.
ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
One who fixes his attention in stillness of mind is rid of the disease of pride and enjoys bliss. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਘਰਿ ਰਤਨ ਲਾਲ ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣਕ ਲਾਦੇ; ਮਨੁ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਆ. ਲਹਿ, ਨ ਸਕਾਈਐ ॥
The home within is loaded with jewels, rubies and pearls, but while the mind wanders they cannot be found.
ਜਿਉ ਓਡਾ, ਕੂਪੁ ਗੁਹਜ ਖਿਨ ਕਾਢੈ; ਤਿਉ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਲਹਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
As a water-diviner quickly finds a buried well, so the treasure of the Name is found through the true Guru. ॥2॥
ਜਿਨ ਐਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੁ. ਨ ਪਾਇਆ; ਤੇ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਨਰ ਜੀਵਾਈਐ ॥
Those who have not found such a true Guru, master of his own mind, live a life that is accursed.
ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪੁੰਨਿ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਕਉਡੀ ਬਦਲੈ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
They gained this precious human birth as the fruit of past good deeds, yet it is going for the price of a cowrie. ॥3॥
ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਈਐ ॥
O Lord, destroyer of the wicked, show mercy and in Your kindness unite me with the Guru.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਿਰਬਾਣ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੪॥੬॥
Says servant Nanak: one who meets the Guru and sings God's virtues reaches the state that no desire can touch. ॥4॥4॥6॥
ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਭਇਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ; ਦੇਹ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸੁੰਞੀ ਸੁੰਞੁ ॥
Through Maya, those who follow their own minds stay in coming and going and in misery; their bodies are empty, utterly empty of the Name.
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ. ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ, ਨਹੀ ਚੇਤਿਆ; ਜਮਿ ਪਕਰੇ, ਕਾਲਿ ਸਲੁੰਞੁ ॥੧॥
They do not remember God's Name for a moment or an instant; spiritual death holds them by the head at all times. ॥1॥
ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਜੀਉ; ਬਿਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਮੁੰਞੁ ॥
O dear Gobind, remove the poison of pride and possessiveness from me.
ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਭੁੰਞੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The company of the holy is dear to You and to the Guru; may I join that company and enjoy the taste of Your Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ; ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਪੰਞੁ ॥
O Lord, in Your mercy keep me in the Guru's holy company; may I stay in the Guru's refuge.
ਹਮ ਡੁਬਦੇ ਪਾਥਰ. ਕਾਢਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਤੁਮੑ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਞੁ ॥੨॥
We are sinking stones; pull us out, O Lord, You who are merciful to the poor and destroy suffering. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਲੰਞੁ ॥
O Lord, my Master, keep Your praise set in my heart; may my understanding be lit up in Your holy company.
ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ. ਹਮ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਨੀ; ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਘੁਮਿ ਵੰਞੁ ॥੩॥
I have come to love God's Name, and I am a sacrifice to God. ॥3॥
ਜਨ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਿ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਲੰਞੁ ॥
O Lord God, fulfil Your servant's aims and give me Your Name, which is my light.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਹੈ; ਗੁਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦੀਓ ਹਰਿ ਭੰਞੁ ॥੪॥੫॥੭॥੧੨॥੧੮॥੭॥੩੭॥
O servant Nanak, one to whom the Guru has given the mantra of God's Name has spiritual bloom in mind and body. ॥4॥5॥7॥12॥18॥7॥37॥
1180: One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
I bow before the Guru and serve him.
Now there is great joy in my heart.
Now there is nothing but gladness within me.
I have met Gobind, and every worry has left me. ॥1॥
Now spiritual bliss stays in the home of my heart,
ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਤੁਮੑ ਬੇਅੰਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
since I began singing Your praises, O infinite Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Now it is as if the Holi of Phagun were being held within me,
God's saints have come together and begun to play it.
I have made service of the saints my Holi.
The deep colour of God's love has taken hold in me. ॥2॥
My mind and body have bloomed in great beauty.
In comfort or in pain, the freshness of this bloom never dries up.
In every season my mind stays full of spiritual life.
I have met the divine Guru, and bloom is always within me. ॥3॥
The Parjat tree, which grants every wish, has sprung up within me,
bearing precious flowers and fruit of many kinds.
By always singing God's virtues, people are fully satisfied.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੪॥੧॥
Says servant Nanak: it comes by always meditating on God's Name. ॥4॥1॥
As a shopkeeper runs a shop of the goods he likes,
as a gambler's mind stays absorbed in gambling,
as an opium-eater feels at ease when he has eaten opium,
ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਜੀਵੈ; ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥
so God's devotee gains spiritual life by meditating on God. ॥1॥
Everyone stays absorbed in the taste he himself likes,
ਜਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਲਾਇਆ; ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
but each is attached to whatever God has attached him to. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
When the clouds gather, the peacocks dance,
at the sight of the moon the water-lilies open,
a mother is glad at the sight of her child,
ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਜੀਵਹਿ; ਜਪਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥੨॥
so God's devotees are lifted in spirit by repeating God's Name. ॥2॥
A lion is always glad of a meal of meat,
at the sight of battle a warrior's heart is roused,
a miser has great greed for wealth,
ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਉ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
so God's devotee has the support of God's Name. ॥3॥
But all tastes are contained in the one taste of God's Name.
ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਸੁਖ; ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ॥
All the greatest comforts are in God's Name.
This treasure is received only by the one
O Nanak, to whom the Guru gives it. ॥4॥2॥
Spiritual bloom comes to the one to whom God is merciful,
spiritual bloom comes to the one to whom the Guru is kind.
ਮੰਗਲੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ; ਜਿਸੁ ਏਕੁ ਕਾਮੁ ॥
Joy arises in the heart of one whose single task is remembering God's Name.
ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦ ਬਸੰਤੁ; ਜਿਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
Bloom is always with the one in whose heart the Name dwells. ॥1॥
I count bloom to have come in the heart of one
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ; ਹਰਿ ਧੁਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
in whose heart God's praise is lodged and devotion to God's Name is alive. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
O my mind, stay in bloom by loving the supreme God.
Understanding of spiritual life is gained by asking the saints.
The real ascetic is one who has the Guru's company,
and one who has love for the Guru is always in meditation. ॥2॥
They are free of fear in whose minds the fear of God dwells.
He is at ease whose wandering of mind has gone.
He alone lives in solitude whose heart is settled in one place.
He alone is unwavering who stays joined to the eternal Lord. ॥3॥
One who seeks the one God alone and loves Him alone,
whose heart longs for the touch of His sight,
who, resting in stillness of mind, enjoys the taste of God's Name, the best of all tastes,
says servant Nanak, to that person I am a sacrifice. ॥4॥3॥
